{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if not col or (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while st:
          y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
              seen.add(q); st.append(q)
        r0=min(y for y,x in cells); c0=min(x for y,x in cells)
        sh={(y-r0,x-c0) for y,x in cells}; hh=max(y for y,x in sh)+1; ww=max(x for y,x in sh)+1
        sym=all((hh-1-y,x) in sh and (y,ww-1-x) in sh for y,x in sh)
        objs.append((col,sh,hh,ww,c0,r0,sym))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Symmetric motifs are packed upward; other motifs downward, retaining columns.
    ordered=sorted([o for o in objs if o[6]],key=lambda o:o[5])
    for col,sh,hh,ww,c0,r0,sym in ordered:
      rr=0
      while rr+hh<=h and any(out[rr+y][c0+x] for y,x in sh): rr+=1
      for y,x in sh:
        if rr+y<h and c0+x<w: out[rr+y][c0+x]=col
    ordered=sorted([o for o in objs if not o[6]],key=lambda o:o[5],reverse=True)
    for col,sh,hh,ww,c0,r0,sym in ordered:
      rr=h-hh
      while rr>=0 and any(out[rr+y][c0+x] for y,x in sh): rr-=1
      if rr<0: rr=h-hh
      for y,x in sh: out[rr+y][c0+x]=col
    return out
",
 "path": "programs/task-aa3d569e.py"
}
